purpose: State-scoped coverage inventory for New York 2024 result, review, turnout, map, historical, and election-administration context sources. This inventory records source availability and blockers; it does not promote production data and does not allege fraud or misconduct.

completionDecision.reason: New York has official county-certified President and U.S. Senate rows, county geometry, EAC fallback turnout, official county historical baselines, and partial supplemental local review rows, but it is not completed native coverage because the local review package is still partial, turnout is not state-native, and precinct/election-district geometry plus normalized audit/CVR/incident/recount/litigation records are not loaded.
completionDecision.promotionCaveat: Do not move NY to completedNativeStates until either statewide official same-grain local review coverage is collected or the coordinator intentionally accepts partial supplemental review coverage with visible caveats.
completionDecision.wave19Decision: Wave 19 keeps NY in sourceDiscoveryQueue. The current staging artifact is useful for county-certified maps and partial local advisory review, but completedNativeStates would overstate official local review, turnout, and geometry coverage.
completionDecision.wave21Decision: Wave 21 rechecked NYSBOE and Flateau/VEDA source surfaces on 2026-07-03. VEDA is live but has no election data/exportable 2024 replacement rows, and NYSBOE county/election-district enrollment reports remain denominator leads only. The final blocker is therefore specific: obtain official same-grain President plus U.S. Senate local rows for the 13 excluded county equivalents, a ballots-cast or voter-history artifact, and geometry/crosswalks before completed native coverage.
completionDecision.wave22Decision: Wave 22 found no new official 2024 statewide/local replacement export and added data/ny-2024-missing-county-request-packets.json plus county-specific request-matrix rows so each missing county equivalent has an operational request packet for same-grain President and U.S. Senate rows, turnout/voter-history fields, and ED geometry/crosswalks.

authorityPriority: Official New York State Board of Elections, county boards of elections, official GIS/Census, EAC, and official court/board records first; OpenElections and Verified Voting remain supplemental context only.

caveats: OpenElections is supplemental and source-linked, not the official NYSBOE statewide local-results package.
Monroe County appears in the manifest with zero parsed rows and remains excluded from loaded review coverage.
Image-only, president-only, unsupported, or unreviewed county source files remain out of the normalized review CSV until extraction is reviewed and reconciled to county certified totals.
The local-review manifest now records loaded, zero-row, and excluded source-file statuses so unnormalized county files remain reviewable without being silently treated as coverage.

They should be replaced only after a state-native New York turnout or voter-participation artifact is collected and reconciled.

officialSourceSearchPath.sourceAuthority: New York State Board of Elections
officialSourceSearchPath.result: The NYSBOE Enrollment by County page lists 2024 county enrollment reports, including Voters Registered by County as of 11/01/2024; this was rechecked on 2026-07-03.
officialSourceSearchPath.blocker: Enrollment reports are denominator leads only. They do not provide ballots-cast/voter-participation rows by themselves, so the active ETL remains EAC fallback until a turnout or voter-history artifact is collected and reconciled.

officialSourceSearchPath.sourceAuthority: New York State Board of Elections
officialSourceSearchPath.result: The NYSBOE Enrollment by Election District page publishes county-by-county election-district enrollment reports by year; the 2024 filter showed 124 results during the 2026-07-03 check.
officialSourceSearchPath.blocker: Election-district enrollment reports are not ballots-cast rows and may not share exact labels with county result exports; a parser and crosswalk are needed before using them for same-grain turnout context.

officialSourceSearchPath.sourceAuthority: New York State Board of Elections
officialSourceSearchPath.result: The Flateau/VEDA site is the official future statewide publication path for election results, poll sites, district maps, downloads, voter-statistics exports, and compliance reports. As checked again on 2026-07-03, the dashboard showed 0 total elections for 2026 and no election data available; the downloads page exposed future CSV/JSON categories but no 2024 selected-election export.
officialSourceSearchPath.blocker: The statute-backed collection path applies to elections on or after April 1, 2026, so it is a future source path rather than a 2024 replacement package.

officialSourceSearchPath.sourceAuthority: New York State Board of Elections
checkedFor: official source mandate for local result rows
voter history and poll-site data publication path
officialSourceSearchPath.result: The NYSBOE Flateau page says election authorities transmit election-district results, contemporaneous registration lists, voter history files, maps or district-configuration documentation, poll-site lists, and adopted districting plans for qualifying elections.
officialSourceSearchPath.blocker: The mandate is not a collected 2024 artifact. Use this path for future statewide official local rows and for request language when asking county boards for 2024 equivalents.

officialSourceSearchPath.sourceAuthority: New York State Board of Elections
officialSourceSearchPath.result: The NYSBOE public reporting system includes a County Board Roster with county filter, summary PDF, and CSV download controls.
officialSourceSearchPath.blocker: Roster data is a request/contact path, not a normalized result, turnout, CVR, audit, or geometry artifact.

officialSourceSearchPath.sourceAuthority: New York State Board of Elections
officialSourceSearchPath.result: The NYSBOE Election Security page documents the post-election audit process under Election Law 9-211, including the three-percent voting-machine/system audit and filing of comparison reports with the State Board.
officialSourceSearchPath.blocker: No 2024 county audit comparison reports are loaded in this repository. Request county or State Board audit selection and comparison reports before normalizing audit rows.

officialSourceSearchPath.sourceAuthority: New York State Board of Elections
checkedFor: CVR, incident, correction, recount, litigation, and voter-file request routing
officialSourceSearchPath.result: The NYSBOE FOIL page identifies GovQA as the online request channel and explains that other records are available by request unless exempt.
officialSourceSearchPath.blocker: CVR availability, incident/correction/recount/litigation records, and some voter-registration data may be custodian-specific or legally restricted; no normalized row package is loaded.

officialSourceSearchPath.sourceAuthority: New York State Board of Elections
officialSourceSearchPath.result: The NYSBOE Voting Technology page publishes official context for voting systems and county technology pages for Clear Ballot, Liberty Vote/ImageCast, ES&S, and Hart Verity.
officialSourceSearchPath.blocker: Voting-system context is not a result, turnout, CVR, audit, or incident row source. County-level assignment history still needs source-native records if replacing supplemental equipment context.

requestPath.caveat: All future request-produced artifacts must be source-linked, scripted, and reconciled to official county-certified totals before they change public review or turnout coverage.

displayCaveats: County-certified NYSBOE President rows remain the map authority.
Local advisory review rows are partial supplemental source normalizations and do not cover image-only, president-only, unsupported, or unreviewed counties.
EAC turnout rows are fallback context until a New York-native turnout/voter-history package is collected and reconciled.
Historical baselines are official county context for 2012, 2016, and 2020 only.
Administration and equipment context is source-linked metadata, not proof of fraud or misconduct.
Wave 22 request packets are operational source-request records only; they do not add loaded rows or change public review coverage.
